title: Idamu Elaphula Umbuso
intro: Izwe elinemifula egelezayo, izingadi ezimbili eziluhlaza, kanye nokuchuma okungenakuqhathaniswa — kodwa izakhamuzi zalo zaqala ukungamnaki Lowo owababusisa. Lapho kufika izikhumbuzo ezibabizayo, baphenduka. Okwalandela kwaba isijeziso esisazwakala njengesixwayiso. Yayingubani le miphakathi yasendulo?
clues: Sasihlala ezweni elibusiswe kakhulu kangangokuthi ikhaya lethu laliphakathi kwezingadi ezimbili eziluhlaza.
Sajabulela imifula egeleza emasimini ethu kanye nesivuno esiningi esigcwalisa amakhaya ethu.
Kodwa lapho sibizelwa ekubongeni nasekulaleleni iNkosi yethu, saphenduka ngokuziqhenya.
Ingcebo yethu kanye nokunethezeka kwethu kwasenza sakhohlwa Lowo owasinika konke.
Kwabe sekufika isikhukhula esingazelelwe esadabula isithiyo esikhulu esasithembele kuso.
Singabantu baseSaba', izwe labo elalaziwa ngeDamu elikhulu laseMa'rib.

outcome.label: Isiphetho Sethu
options: Izingadi ezimbili ezibabayo zathatha indawo yezimila zethu ezinhle
Izingadi zethu zakhula zaba ziningi kakhulu
Isizwe sethu sahlukana saba izizwe eziyishumi nambili
outcome.answer: Izingadi ezimbili ezibabayo zathatha indawo yezimila zethu ezinhle

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
